articles.title: Russian strikes plunge Ukrainian city into blackout as Zelenskyy warns of more missile attacks
articles.description: Russian strikes caused major power outages in Dnipro as a reported Ukrainian drone attack sparked a fire at a Russian oil refinery.

articles.title: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts

articles.title: Wall Street braces for Democratic gains as 2026 midterm election nears

articles.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower

articles.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses

articles.title: Tech giants need legacy businesses to keep growing as they pour trillions into the AI buildout

articles.title: Gen Z is ditching bars for run clubs — and finding more than friends along the way
